Package com.codeup.novabook.jdbc

Interface JdbcTemplateLight.SqlTxCallback<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of result returned by the callback
Enclosing class:
JdbcTemplateLight
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface JdbcTemplateLight.SqlTxCallback<T>
Functional interface for transactional callback operations.

This interface defines a callback that can perform multiple database operations within a single transaction. The connection is managed by the calling JdbcTemplateLight.txExecute(SqlTxCallback) method.
